headline: Saquon Snaps a Spine, Bo Nix Celli Eats 51 in the Mouth
subhead: Week 12 was a bloodbath — three 50-burgers, a 1-point heart attack, and The Good Ladds left an entire flex on the pine.
matchOfTheWeek: Stroud Boys vs T swift's Baddies came down to a Jonnu Smith miracle (28.2, lol) and a 1.04 margin that probably hinged on a garbage-time PAT. Tnicolle is somewhere staring at the ceiling fan replaying every kicker decision of her life. Stroud Boys win the coin flip dressed as a football game.
powerRankingsShakeup: LargestofRocks dropped a league-high 163.52 and is officially that guy. 226 Alpha and Bo Nix Celli are in free fall — a combined 207 points and zero dignity between them.
mainRecap:
Let's start with the crime scene at Put an AR to My Head 158, Bo Nix Celli 106. Saquon Barkley posted 46.2 — that's not a fantasy score, that's a felony. Jordan Addison chipped in 30 because apparently Vikings receivers only show up when KyleDech needs them. Nickcelli, buddy, naming your team after Bo Nix was cute in September. In late November it reads like a suicide note.

Over in the Olave Garden, Patrickreegs took 226 Alpha behind the woodshed by 52.44. Szara's squad scraped together a league-low 100.68 — the kind of number that makes you check if you accidentally started a bye-week tight end at QB. Spoiler: he probably did.

Jets' Juniors smoked OnlyFants by 37 because Courtland Sutton remembered he plays football (29.7) and ChrisCubby's roster remembered it does not. Hot Cocks handled The Good Ladds, but the real story there is Mig56 leaving 45.96 points on the bench — Noah Gray dropped 24.6 in street clothes while Mig started a tight end who did approximately jack. Ameer Abdullah added another 17.5 from the bench just to twist the knife. That's not a bad week, that's malpractice.

The game of the week was LargestofRocks 163, MassiveCocks 151 — a 315-point shootout where 7BigPapi7 got 28+ from THREE different players (Mahomes, Tua, Waddle) and still lost. Why? Because LargestofRocks ALSO left 21 points of Sam Darnold, 19 of Nick Chubb, and 18 of Zach Ertz on his bench and STILL won by 12. That's just disrespectful. Dude is starting his JV team and lapping the league.

And Stroud Boys squeaked past T swift's Baddies by 1.04. Bjewett, frame the box score. Tnicolle, burn yours.
